- Thu Jan 14, 2026 — 10:00–10:40 PT — US/EMEA live session (40 minutes) focused on marketplace listing and buyer flows (recorded as well).

Plan B (fallback if presenter conflicts):
- Single live session Thu Jan 14, 10:00 PT (US/EMEA) + a recorded APAC segment distributed same day with a 30-min live Q&A the following week.

Preflight: we suggest a 30-min tech check the day before each live session. Kimberly, can your team host preflight on Jan 13 15:00 PT (or suggest another 30-min window)?
